newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha ends slightly higher, tracks crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha ends slightly higher, tracks crude.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices ended slightly higher on Monday, tracking crude oil futures in an otherwise balanced and quiet market.
"Demand is pretty hopeless," said one broker. "(The market) is being driven by arb opportunities and the Skikda closings."
Dec swaps ended up about $2 at $225.25/$226.25, following crude lower and then higher this afternoon.
With December having arrived some players may choose to run down inventories this month for end-year tax purposes, but that could lead to tightness later this month that would boost prices, he said.
Algeria's Skikda port remained closed but traders said that was not boosting NWE prices, since the four tankers waiting to be loaded have homes.

One end user in NWE waiting for a large tanker at Skikda appears to have been picking up smaller parcels to satisfy its prompt demand. An 18,000 tonne Spanish cargo was believed to have been bought at Friday at high quotes +$3 into Rotterdam.
Cargoes were notionally up $2 at $226/$228 cif.
